title: useQueue Hook
description:
Implement a `useQueue` hook that manages a FIFO queue and returns `{ queue, enqueue, dequeue, peek, size }`. `enqueue(item)` adds to the back. `dequeue()` removes the front item. `peek` is the front item (or `undefined` if empty). `size` is the current length.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { queue, enqueue, dequeue, peek, size } = useQueue([]);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: implementing dequeue with queue.shift() which mutates the existing array — always create a new array with slice(1) so React detects the state change.
